title: 2018 — #02 — Shibby Live and Impromptu (Session #02 - Part 2)
description: If you've never been to one of my live recordings, you can still listen in to almost the whole thing whenever you'd like. During this live recording, I recorded two scripts from GWA which I now have out, two of my own improvs that I released (edited), and "Toys" which I just released for free a few days ago. This is your chance to see how it sounded before I started playing with it in audacity. "Toys" is the entirety of the second file, and you should keep in mind that this is completely unedited, so there is no special effects or backgrounds - every smack of my lip, every sip of water I take and movement of my chair is still in it, because fuck editing a three hour podcast audio. I am not going to tag the live recording file, so understand you are going into this sort of blind. Enjoy!
author: Mistress Shibby
